descriptionHtml:
Bug B23 · P1 · known

Patient cards are missing fields: age shows '76y' not '76F', Hospital cards have no hospital day, Nursing Home cards no visit number

Tickets: TFA-92579 AC3–4 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-01/S05, TC-01/S06, TC-01/S26

Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S03 Card field × context: every required field present, diagnosis only on Hospital

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Each patient renders as a card on the home screen showing the patient's first and last name and room (Nursing Home: unit/room). (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 3)
  • U2 The card shows the chief diagnosis on Hospital cards only; a Nursing Home card shows no diagnosis. (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 3; UAT TC-03)
  • U3 The card shows age/sex in the "76F" format. (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 3)
  • U4 The card shows the New Admission / Follow-up / Consult badge. (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 3)
  • U5 The card shows the hospital day (Hospital) or the visit number (Nursing Home). (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 3)
  • U8 With multiple patients loaded, everything above holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-01; UAT 3.3)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given seededCensus; H1 and N1 are checked here, with H2 and N2 (same last names) on the same lists

When Search each list for the patient's full name so only that card is shown, and snapshot it; NH on both Today's Visits and All Residents

Then Hospital card: name, room, diagnosis, '76F'-style age/sex, badge, hospital day. NH card: name, unit/room, age/sex, badge, visit number, and no diagnosis even though one is stored

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Decision table (field rows × context columns: required / absent) from UAT TC-01, TC-03 and AC 3. oracle.mjs per checkpoint: the list marker 'Open chart for <name>', the expected values, and no 'pre-round notes' (chart only). 'Day 3' and 'Visit 1' assume Q2/Q3 defaults; '87F' and 'Visit 1' cells may move with Q4. Card ownership of a value is judged in S26 (card-scoped), not here

Where it ran: dev unit U27; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment dev · tickets TFA-92579 ready for qa; TFA-92581 ready for qa

Patient cards show age as '76y' with no sex instead of '76F' and show no hospital day or visit number, and the Nursing Home card also shows the diagnosis.

Evidence: dev U27 (ledger #27). Already in dev report §2 #5 (C2: age/sex, day/visit number; TFA-92579 AC 3–4) and §2 #4 (C1: NH diagnosis). The sex part depends on TC-01 Q1: the app has no way to enter sex. The local datasets lane failed on the same cells.

Folded in: local datasets TC-01/S03 (same failure, folded into this result)

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
